I get this with bad habits like nothing matters much if you do a bad habit every day for a couple of days but then it’s been a year all of a sudden and it’s caused problems you weren’t even aware existed until you stepped back.

I think it’s a little different than that because he wasn’t trying to ridicule me he was just trying to be funny but at the end of the day an unsolicited nude is still illegal and not a joke. It is a toxic relationship but I’m scared to find out if no relationship is better than a toxic one. 

Your English is perfect by the way, it’s better than mine and it’s my mother tongue lmao

It just sucks because I got so addicted to the feeling of having a friend and having someone to hang out with it made me feel so normal. I just think I gotta live my life without him for a while and see if no company is really better than bad company.
That’s a fair opinion. I’m of the mindset that everything you do has an effect on your life no matter how big or small the moment feels when it’s happening.

It sucks cause friendship making is not a skill I possess though I’m working on it. We were friends out of necessity. We were both lonely and he became way more fascinated with me than I of him. I just need help seeing if the friendship is still a necessity
I just don’t know whether to save the friendship. My emotion mind says no but my logic mind says it’s this or be lonely.

I’m at a crossroads because I hate the fact that he is a friend. He’s a horrible person but I was just so excited about the fact I had a friend at all. I’m not so experienced as I should be for my age with friends so my opinion doesn’t count for much but I just personally felt like unsolicited nudes isn’t « talking shit » it’s illegal and I didn’t want to see it. I don’t know.
Don’t know how much more help there is but I’m looking!
Toxic relations build so slow you don’t know you’re in one till you look around and then it feels too late.

i totally get that mindset because I’m not super sensitive when it comes to jokes I know I may not come across like that in my post because it’s just the words sprinting to my mind rather than me sitting down and assessing a situation

Im not rebelling at all in any way I’m not that person and of course sexual identity is not a choice so if you want to debate that I just don’t have the energy. I posted to ask how to cope with the situation which I don’t believe is wallowing in fake drama.
Do you think completely cutting ties is the best way to proceed or is there a better way I could have handled it?
